definitions.gloss: to snatch away, to seize, to wrest, to grab forcefully
definitions.explanation: To take something from someone by force or aggressive action. Stronger than simply taking — implies overcoming resistance or competition.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}った。
⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}って⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The thief snatched the bag and ran away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}った。
examples.english: The player seized victory at the last moment.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb from ⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧ (to rob, take) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). The combination emphasizes the forceful, decisive nature of the action. Used both literally (physical snatching) and figuratively (seizing victory, power, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to seize victory
- ⟦{主導権|しゅどうけん}→主導権：11451_shudouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to wrest the initiative
- ⟦{力|ちから}ずく→力ずく：29143_chikarazuku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to take by force
